# Whale Balance · 余额水杯
English · 中文
**English** — A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that turns your account balance into water inside the
whale mark: the level fills against a full amount you set, the surface keeps rippling, and a hover p
anel shows exact amounts, spend, remaining days and a top-up link.
**中文** — 把 DeepSeek 账户余额显示成鲸鱼标志里上涨的水面：水位按你设置的满杯金额线性变化，水面持续荡漾；悬停面板给出精确金额、今日/近 7 天消耗、还能用几天，以及充值入口。

### Install

Then enable **Whale Balance** on the Plugins page. The plugin is also listed in the Open Plugin Mark
et — add `https://dshopen.org/index.json` under **Discover → Add index source** and search for `whal
//dshopen.org/index.json` under **Discover → Add index source** and search for `whale` or `balance`.
### What you get
- A 46px floating whale mark in the bottom-right corner (`shell.overlay`). Drag it anywhere; the pos

ition is remembered and clamped to the window.
- Clicking the mark unfolds it into a pill with a Cas
io-style LCD face on the right showing the live total: seven-segment digits, faint ghost segments, a
nd a short digit churn when the amount changes. The pill hugs the amount instead of reserving a wide
empty display. It unfolds toward the side with room — left by default, and when a dragged chip cann
ot fit to the right, it keeps its right edge and grows leftwards instead of leaving the window. Clic

k again to fold it back; otherwise it stays open.
- Water height = `balance / full amount`, capped a

t full. The full amount is per currency and set in the panel's gear.
- Two drifting wave layers insi

de the whale silhouette, plus a ±4° sway of the mark so the tail moves most.
- Live balance from the
account watch stream: login, top-up and sign-out push a frame immediately. Falls back to 60 s polli

ng when the stream is unavailable.
- Hover panel: wallet totals with the bonus share in parentheses
(gift icon + amount); click a currency to make it the vessel's basis. Also today's and last-7-day sp

end, an estimate of remaining days, a low-balance warning, refresh, and **Top up**.
- Clicking the m

ark only unfolds or folds the LCD face — it never navigates; top-up has its own link.
- Low balance:
amber water and a soft breathing glow around the mark's edge. The threshold is either an amount or

a percentage of the full amount.
- Only theme tokens for the container, focus rings and text; `prefe
rs-reduced-motion` disables the ripples, sway, breathing glow and spinner. UI is localized (English
motion` disables the ripples, sway, breathing glow and spinner. UI is localized (English / Chinese).
### Settings
| Setting | Default | Notes |
| Full amount | ¥100 (USD $15) | Spendable total (recharge + bonus) at which the vessel is full; set

1000 to make 1000 the top |
| Alert mode | amount | `amount` or `percent` |
| Alert threshold | ¥5

(USD $1) | Below it the water turns amber and the mark's edge glows softly |
| Percent threshold | 1
0% | Used in percent mode: threshold = full amount × percent |
Full amount and amount threshold are stored per currency (CNY / USD); the percentage is global. Ever
ything lives in `localStorage` and applies immediately; **Reset** restores the defaults.
### How the level works

- Linear: `(recharge + bonus) / full amount`, capped at 1. 40 of 100 fills 40% of the height.
- Spen
d figures come from the balance decreases this plugin observes while the app runs, so they are an es
timate, not a bill. The ledger tracks the recharge and bonus wallets together (the platform spends t
he bonus first), and both the today and 7-day rows are always shown — `0.00` when nothing has been o

bserved yet.
- Days left divides the usable total (recharge + bonus) by the extrapolated daily spend
from the last seven days of observations, and stays hidden until there is at least one day of histo
om the last seven days of observations, and stays hidden until there is at least one day of history.
### Where the data comes from
The browser reads the same account Remote as **Settings → Account**:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
No API key is stored and the plugin makes no external network requests.
### Limits
- Spend history and settings are kept in `localStorage` per origin; a desktop build that changes por

ts starts collecting again.
- Spend is observed only while the app is running, so long offline perio
ds are not attributed.

### 它在哪里
`shell.overlay` 里的一块 46px 悬浮徽标，默认在窗口右下角（距边 20px），不占布局、不遮挡滚动区域。

- **拖动**：按住徽标可拖到任意位置，松手后记住坐标（窗口缩小时会自动收回可视区）。
[该节后续省略]

- 「可用天数」依赖已观察到的消耗，长时间不用时消耗为 0，该项不显示
